Fuess and Stearns, comps.  The Little Book of Society Verse.  1922.

By. Robert Herrick

To Sapho

T
HOU
 saist thou lov’st me, 
Sapho;
 I say no;
But would to Love I could beleeve ’twas so!
Pardon my feares (sweet 
Sapho
) I desire
That thou be righteous found; and I the Lyer.
